sources.title: How to use the Qwen 3.5 LLMs to OCR documents
sources.snippet: Running Qwen 3.5 Qwen 3.5 is an open weights model (you can download and use the model as you want) from Alibaba. They're really good, and I think it does pass a bit of a threshold of capabilities in small open weights models. Crucially, all of these models are multimodal - they can handle text and vision input.
